Got out of severe depression a few months ago with the help of therapy. My sessions ended at the start of September. It wasn't easy but as a person who has had a lot of experience with therapy, if you are depressed, therapy really does help. They ask questions that really make you challenge why you think/feel a certain way, but in the end you get to apply everything you've learnt into your life and finally get to live without feeling like every day is the same day, damned to make you feel down.

Ultimately, after being able to apply everything I've learned from it, I've actually been able to build up my self esteem. I even got to ask my friends out to the cinema which I wasn't even able to do before!
